waivers.verdict: Hold — no FAAB move clears the bar this week. Keep Will Reichard at kicker and the Bears at defense. This morning's swap is a lateral bench move: Malik Washington's bye lands a week before the hole Diggs and Meyers create, so he covers it exactly as well as Roman Wilson did.

lineup.verdict: Hold this week's lineup — Jared Goff and Kirk Cousins still start at QB and SUPER_FLEX over a Questionable Lamar Jackson; nothing new on either Jackson or tonight's Buccaneers game changes that.

trades.verdict: Still send Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara to amandaberry — today's bench swap didn't touch this, and Kamara himself now showing a Questionable tag doesn't change the case either way.

inactives.verdict: No games close enough to check yet — Thursday night's Buccaneers-Cowboys game is the only one anywhere near kickoff, and nobody has an official game-day status.

actions.name: Lamar Jackson
actions.why: Only quarterback left in SUPER_FLEX if Cousins trades away — Young is on bye, so Jackson fills it whether or not his tag has cleared by then.

actions.message: Kirk Cousins for Alvin Kamara — you're all-in at RB (Gibbs/Robinson start, Kamara/Dowdle/Gainwell stacked behind them) but carrying zero backup QB in a superflex league. Cousins is the Raiders' clear starter. With Etienne down for a month, Kamara's a bench piece I'd rather have than you would right now.

evidence.note: Travis Etienne is on IR with a hamstring injury (out at least four games, not back before W9); Kamara projects into New Orleans' lead backfield role while he's out.

actions.why: Kamara leads NO's backfield with Etienne on IR; still good value off a 4-QB bench, but Cousins is now my live starter, not spare depth.
